description: This file defines the class ListViewSmarty, which extends ListViewDisplay and manages the presentation logic for list views in the SuiteCRM application. It includes methods for processing data, rendering templates, and handling various list view configurations.

classes.name: ListViewSmarty
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering list views using Smarty templates, supporting features like sorting, filtering, context menus, mass updates, and link actions within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ListViewSmarty object and its Smarty engine.

methods.name: buildSendConfirmOptInEmailToPersonAndCompany
methods.description: Builds a link or returns false based on the confirmation opt-in configuration.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes list data, assigns template variables, and prepares rendering of the list view.

methods.name: processArrows
methods.description: Assigns sorting arrow images to the template based on current sorting order.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the list view, either returning the HTML output or echoing it, with support for pagination, filters, and actions.

methods.name: getSearchIcon
methods.description: Generates the search icon link for the list view if applicable.

methods.name: displayEnd
methods.description: Returns HTML for mass update forms and closing tags for the list view.
